reuse.why: All rules go into the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount, Fintegra links through it, and the unlink column reset is extracted into clearBankLink that unlinkAccount now also uses.

duplication.why: No duplicated rule logic; the only copy is downloadFintegraTransactions mirroring the Akahu download, which follows the tree's one-function-per-provider convention.

placement.why: Link rules sit in the common link path in accounts/app.ts, provider plumbing in sync.ts/server-config/types, as the tree lays them out.

scope.why: Focused on the four steps; the desktop-client edits are type-driven registrations (Record over SYNC_PROVIDERS) rather than UI work, plus a release note.

maintainability.why: Future providers inherit both guards and the takeover by going through linkBankSyncAccount, and the local unlink is defined once.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No bypass; Fintegra and the takeover both use the shared link path and the extracted clearBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: The only copy (Fintegra download vs Akahu download) is a plain, conventional per-provider function.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains replaceExistingLink and one flag-driven takeover branch; the closed and duplicate checks are general rules, not special cases, and every provider link goes through it.
